observation_or_arm: Premise: the null-neuron deficit in the existing co-culture, reproduced blind with independent preparations and axon-density denominators, cortical beside DRG neurons (OQ12)
if_effect_present: deficit reproduced: every arm below is interpretable
if_effect_absent: deficit not reproduced: nothing below is interpretable; stop
compatible_with_all_three: the published two-experiment deficit (about 49 versus 29 percent hand-read MBP+ share, n 4 v 4, DRG) is compatible with all three
control_that_interprets_a_null: none; this is the premise itself
label: DATO (premise as published); the gate is INFERENZA

observation_or_arm: OPC monoculture with conditioned medium from null versus wild-type neurons, matched for neuron number and viability, against a fresh-medium baseline
if_effect_present: MBP+ share lower with null medium than wild-type medium by more than the monoculture's own between-preparation variance
if_effect_absent: no difference between null and wild-type medium while the positive control works
favours: effect present: a soluble channel (E1), but E2 in its medium form is not excluded until O2 and O3; effect absent with a working positive control: E3, not a short-lived factor
compatible_with_all_three: an effect with unmatched neuron number or unshown purity is compatible with E1, E2 and E3 read through non-neuronal DRG cells
control_that_interprets_a_null: positive-control medium that works in the same run (recombinant CTGF or Tsc2-knockdown neuron medium, authors' claim, queried depth); neuron purity shown; detection limit from the monoculture variance, not the 20-point co-culture gap
held_source: SCI50 H4 final form; OQ9; OQ11
label: DATO (controls as held); outcomes INFERENZA

observation_or_arm: Mixing arm (null medium with wild-type medium) and a dilution series of null medium
if_effect_present: effect persists in the mixture and falls graded with dilution: an inhibitor (E1)
if_effect_absent: effect disappears on mixing with wild-type medium: a missing cue or depletion (E2 medium form) rather than an inhibitor
favours: E1 versus the medium form of E2
control_that_interprets_a_null: a mixing arm needs the fresh-medium baseline of O1 to say which direction the cue runs
label: DATO (arm as held); outcomes INFERENZA

observation_or_arm: Per-dish composition readouts: neuron number, viability, fraction of non-neuronal DRG cells, axon density and calibre, T3, T4 and a nutrient in conditioned versus fresh medium
if_effect_present: medium effect tracks neuron number, purity or depletion: E2 explains it
if_effect_absent: medium effect survives matching and purification: E2 is not the explanation of the medium effect
favours: E2 versus E1 on the medium arm; E2 versus E3 on denominators in the co-culture
compatible_with_all_three: the raw co-culture deficit is compatible with all three until denominators are scored
control_that_interprets_a_null: a purified-neuron medium arm; blind scoring of denominators
held_source: SCI50 H4 final form (B27/T3 caveat, neuron purity); OQ7; OQ11
label: DATO (items as held); outcomes INFERENZA

observation_or_arm: OPCs on fixed null versus fixed wild-type neurons (no secretion, no activity) and a transwell arm (shared medium, no contact)
if_effect_present: deficit persists on fixed null neurons: contact or substrate (E3); deficit recovers in the transwell: a soluble channel including factors lost in conditioning (E1)
if_effect_absent: fixed null neurons do not lower maturation and the transwell shows nothing: contact needs live neurons or the factor is activity-dependent; not separated
favours: E3 against E1, and a short-lived factor against a stable one when O1 is null but the transwell is positive
compatible_with_all_three: a deficit in the live co-culture alone
control_that_interprets_a_null: fixed wild-type neurons must support OPC maturation at all (not stated in any held source), otherwise a fixed-neuron null is uninterpretable
held_source: fixed neurons: INV-06 next_test clause ('add a fixed-neuron arm and a factor arm'; SCI50 H4 strongest alternative); transwell: NOT in INV-06 text, my proposal with it36 precedent (comparison.tsv ALT2, experiments.tsv)
label: DATO (fixed-neuron arm as held); transwell, the fixation limit and outcomes are INFERENZA

observation_or_arm: Candidate neutralisation (a reagent against the named candidate) and recombinant candidate on wild-type medium
if_effect_present: neutralisation removes a null-medium effect: that candidate carries E1; recombinant candidate lowers maturation: sufficiency in the dish
if_effect_absent: neutralisation does nothing: the candidate is not the factor; E1 itself is not rejected
favours: identifies a candidate within E1; separates nothing between E1, E2 and E3
compatible_with_all_three: an expression change of the candidate in Wwox-null tissue is compatible with all three (expression is not secretion; ADV-007: composition-confounded, mouse tables disagree in sign)
control_that_interprets_a_null: only after O1 is positive; a neutralising reagent with its own positive control
held_source: SCI50 H4 (CTGF only in Tsc models, authors' claim); ADV-007 README and per_table.tsv T1 to T8
label: DATO (held statements); outcomes INFERENZA
